enforcement.previously: the 35 h per-identity ceiling and the storage gate existed only as constants and helper functions with no call site in the execution path, so neither could have halted anything. Nothing summed GPU hours across cells.
enforcement.now: run.per_identity_gate reads an append-only ledger (gpu_hour_ledger.json) and is checked BEFORE every core cell against that cell's projected cost, then re-checked AFTER the cell against its MEASURED hours, which are charged to the ledger. run.storage_gate is checked before every cell. Both halt through gate_halt.
enforcement.verified: the executable gate reproduces the published 34.803 h to within rounding, and it RESERVES the cells that have not run yet -- charging each the greater of its projected and its actual cost -- so a rate overrun is detected on the first cell that shows it rather than after most of the arm is burned.

That is a rise of 2.117 h from the original 32.686 h. 5 separate omissions were found and corrected across seven review rounds, every one of them raising the total; the measurement phase then raised it again. e8b_identity_reconciliation.verdict: CLEARED ON RESOURCES, pending the user's final execution approval. The complete MEASURED programme projects to 34.803 h against the amended 40.0 h ceiling, leaving 5.197 h of raw headroom. The 1.0 h operational floor is enforced against the ceiling, so the ENFORCEABLE automatic recovery margin is 4.195 h -- LESS than the 4.249 h largest cell. A worst-case retry therefore does NOT fit automatically and halts for a fresh decision; that is the authorised policy of 2026-08-08, not a defect. Routine execution is gated against the 34.805 h measured baseline, so an estimate that merely drifts halts rather than quietly spending the recovery margin. The ceiling was raised on RESOURCE grounds before any cell ran and with no result in existence, and no scientific component was changed to obtain the margin. Of the 6 open risks listed above, 3 could still on its own consume the contingency. TRAINING_AUTHORIZED is unchanged: no core cell may start without a separate explicit approval.
